Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates near-complete opacification (whiteout) of the right hemithorax with a contralateral mediastinal shift to the left, which is the classic radiographic appearance of a massive pleural effusion exerting mass effect. Atelectasis would cause an ipsilateral shift, while pneumothorax would appear hyperlucent rather than opaque.
